Subject: Clarification on Monthly Team Review Process

Dear Team,

I hope this email finds you well. I am writing to provide a brief clarification regarding our monthly team review process, ensuring that we are all aligned and prepared for the upcoming meetings.

At the start of each month, our team leader will convene a meeting to review our collective progress and discuss any challenges or successes from the previous month. During these sessions, we will focus on key performance indicators (KPIs) and projects, setting goals for the upcoming month. It is important that each team member prepares a summary of their achievements and areas for improvement to share during the meeting.

If you have any questions or need further guidance on how to prepare for these reviews, please do not hesitate to reach out. Your feedback and insights are crucial to the success of these meetings, and I am here
